title: Formal weakly enriched category theory
summary: A formal category theory is constructed (in the form of a proarrow equipment), encoding weak coherent enrichment over a monoidal model category $\mV$. We describe how basic categorical concepts formulated via the equipment translate back to enriched categories. We characterize Dwyer-Kan equivalences of enriched categories as $2$-categorical equivalences.
